newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Burlington Northern cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Burlington Northern cut.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers said on Monday it had cut its rating for Burlington Northern Santa Fe Corp to buy from strong buy.
-- The firm also cut its 1998 earnings estimate to $8 a share from $8.50.
-- Analyst James Valentine wrote in a report that the company stood to lose the most of any major railroad from deregulation of utilities.
-- "The merger of Santa Fe into the former Burlington Northern is taking longer than planned, and as such we have had to push out the timing of the merger savings."
-- Valentine gave the stock a buy rating since it was still relatively cheap.
-- The company's stock fell one point to 88-7/8 in late-morning trade in midday exchange trade.
